design_brief.description: Linear-shaft bearing block housing for an 8 mm round shaft, with a raised bore centerline offset and a flanged base. Includes a mounting flange with a 28 mm x 45 mm screw-hole pattern. Overall geometry defined by shaft center height and base flange height.

metadata.description: Miniature linear-shaft bearing block housing scaled from primary total_length=8mm, with raised bore centerline and flanged base, including 4-hole mounting pattern.

total_length_mm.description: Primary anchor dimension; all other dimensions derived proportionally.

shaft_centerline_offset_mm.description: Vertical offset of bore centerline above main body mid-height reference; scaled.

height_to_shaft_center_mm.description: Distance from base bottom to shaft centerline; scaled.

base_flange_height_mm.description: Overall height of the base flange region; scaled.

mounting_hole_count.description: Fixed at 4 for the rectangular pattern.

edge_fillet_radius_mm.description: Small edge softening proxy; used as chamfer/relief scale.

bore_length_mm.description: Length of bore cut; slightly longer than block_length_mm to guarantee through-cut.

mounting_hole_depth_mm.description: Depth of mounting holes; equals flange_thickness_mm + small overlap.

sketch.prompt:

Use thin black lines only — no shading, no color, no photorealism, no perspective distortion. Keep proportions realistic. Show the front or three-quarter view that most clearly reveals all canonical parts of the object. If helpful, label key dimensions in millimeters with small arrows, but keep labels sparse. The sketch should look like a designer's concept drawing, suitable as a reference for a parametric CAD model.

OBJECT: A linear-shaft bearing block: 8 mm shaft bore, 13 mm centre-line offset, 26 mm height to shaft centre, 21 mm base flange height, 28 mm x 45 mm mounting-screw pattern.
REQUIRED PARTS (must be visible in the sketch): main_body, shaft_bore, base_flange, right_trapezoid, linear_bearing, veroboard_base, pcb_base
PROPORTIONAL CONSTRAINTS — total_length = 8mm (category: bolt).
All other parts of the sketch must scale consistently with this total size — no exaggerated wheels, handles, or details.

NOTE: Mounting hole diameter, overall block envelope, and whether holes are clearance/counterbored are not specified by the request; values provided are placeholders and should be confirmed. Define clear datums: base mounting plane (Z=0), longitudinal axis (X), transverse axis (Y), and offset direction for the 13 mm centerline offset.
